thought: I just tried to place the brick wall next to the pipe, but the game displayed a red "X," indicating that this position is not correct. Upon closer inspection, I realized that the distance between the two elements is too great, which is why the system is indicating a collision. I need to move the brick wall closer to the pipe so that it is right next to it, ensuring that there is no overlap between the two.
